note: This record is additive. design-record.json, postlabel-replay.json, postlabel-replay-plan.json and public-panel-differential.json are unmodified, and lib/vhh-numbering-v06.ts remains byte-identical to the SHA-256 that postlabel-replay.json binds, so that study's candidateFrozenBeforeReplay claim still holds.

design-record.json therefore still reads productionIntegrated: false. That was true when it was written and is the state the study was conducted under; this record supersedes it rather than editing it.

promotion.from: lib/vhh-numbering.ts, v0.5 policy, engine labelled immunum 1.2.0
promotion.to: lib/vhh-numbering.ts delegating to lib/vhh-numbering-v06.ts, engine labelled immunum 1.3.0

primaryFinding.description: Every audit reported IMGT numbering provenance as immunum 1.2.0 while the installed and executed engine was 1.3.0. The label was a hardcoded constant that was not updated when the dependency was upgraded to fix long-CDR3 suffix clipping.

secondaryChange.description: The promoted policy additionally requires the engine's alignment confidence to clear 0.5 explicitly, bounds-checks the query window, type-checks every numbering entry, and cross-checks the number-map-derived IMGT regions against the engine's independent segment() output with complete nonempty FR1/CDR1/FR2/CDR2/FR3/CDR3/FR4 coverage. A chain failing any of these is now reported unavailable rather than numbered on partial evidence.

measuredBehaviouralChange.summary: Across every executed comparison, engine provenance is the only field that moves. No numbering status, region assignment, CDR length, contact share, evidence band or ranking input changes.

pinnedByteIntegrity.description: tests/v05-validation-artifacts.test.mjs pins the live scientific-core bytes by SHA-256. Promoting necessarily moves that pin, because lib/vhh-numbering.ts is in the pinned set and there is no route to changing production numbering that does not touch a pinned file.
pinnedByteIntegrity.howTheReplacementIsStronger: Live bytes are now checked against the v0.6 attestation, the v0.5 archived objects are still verified against their own recorded digests, and a new regression asserts that exactly one scientific-core file differs between the two attestations. The previous pin proved only that the core had not drifted; the replacement proves that it drifted in precisely the one file this promotion is about.
regressionsAdded: the v0.6 promotion moved exactly one scientific-core file and preserved every v0.5 attestation
both implementation snapshots verify against their own checksum manifests

interpretationBoundary: This promotion corrects a provenance misstatement and tightens numbering acceptance. It changes no measured scientific output, and it establishes nothing about binding, affinity, specificity, state selectivity or pose correctness.
